judgements.rationale: For this public browsing use-case, user-reach applied to every acceptance criterion because any visitor or reader can encounter the catalog. Change-frequency additionally applied to tile-content criteria because listing templates and presentation controls are likely to change during merchandising or UX updates. Money, auth, and data-loss did not apply because the source explicitly defined the catalog as showcase-only with no purchase or account gate.
